title: The Day of the Lord, Final Instructions

questions.question: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need to have anything written to you. For you yourselves are fully aware that the day of the Lord will come like a ____ in the night.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:1-2 (ESV): "Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need to have anything written to you. For you yourselves are fully aware that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night."

questions.question: While people are saying, "There is peace and security," then sudden destruction will come upon them as ____ comes upon a pregnant woman.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:3 (ESV): "While people are saying, 'There is peace and security,' then sudden destruction will come upon them as labor pains come upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape."

questions.question: But you are not in darkness, brothers, for that day to surprise you like a thief. For you are all children of light, children of the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:5 (ESV): "For you are all children of light, children of the day. We are not of the night or of the darkness."

questions.question: So then let us not sleep, as others do, but let us keep awake and be ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:6 (ESV): "So then let us not sleep, as others do, but let us keep awake and be sober."

questions.question: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, are drunk at night. But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, having put on the ____ of faith and love,
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (ESV): "But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet the hope of salvation."

questions.question: And for a helmet the hope of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (ESV): "and for a helmet the hope of salvation."

questions.question: For God has not destined us for wrath, but to obtain ____ through our Lord Jesus Christ,
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:9 (ESV): "For God has not destined us for wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,"

questions.question: We ask you, brothers, to ____ those who labor among you and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (ESV): "We ask you, brothers, to respect those who labor among you and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,"

questions.question: And to esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Be at ____ among yourselves.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:13 (ESV): "and to esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves."

questions.question: See that no one repays anyone evil for evil, but always seek to do ____ to one another and to everyone.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:15 (ESV): "See that no one repays anyone evil for evil, but always seek to do good to one another and to everyone."

questions.question: Give ____ in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 (ESV): "give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you."

questions.question: Do not quench the ____. Do not despise prophecies.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:19-20 (ESV): "Do not quench the Spirit. Do not despise prophecies,"

questions.question: But ____ everything; hold fast what is good.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:21 (ESV): "but test everything; hold fast what is good."

questions.question: Now may the God of peace himself sanctify you completely, and may your whole ____ and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 5:23 (ESV): "Now may the God of peace himself sanctify you completely, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ."

key_verse_text: Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
